name: llava-bench-in-the-wild
description: A collection of real-world multimodal prompts intended to evaluate vision+language models on open-ended, image-grounded understanding and reasoning. It measures how well models can answer questions, follow instructions, and reason about diverse in-the-wild images rather than curated synthetic examples.
reputation: Derived from the LLaVA community and used for practical multimodal model testing; moderately adopted by researchers working on VLMs.
